name: crosscheck
description: Multi-model workflows for Claude Code: /dual-plan and /tri-plan (rival models critique a plan until convergence), /dual-review and /tri-review (independent reviewers on the same diff, merged and adversarially verified), /tri-decide (blind proposals for hard-to-reverse architecture decisions), /tri-strategy (three assigned lenses over one evidence pack for business decisions), and /tri-research (one researcher, two auditors, and a claim ledger they verify row by row).
